title: Looplook: An integrative suite for target assignment and functional annotation of chromatin interactions
text: Welcome looplook, versatile R/Bioconductor toolkit developed integrate three-dimensional (3D) chromatin architecture data (e.g., HiChIP, ChIA-PET, Hi-C) tabular omics datasets, including transcriptomics, chromatin accessibility, protein-DNA interactions (derived ChIP-seq, CUT&Tag, CUT&RUN), genetic variants annotated genome-wide association studies (GWAS). Numerous studies demonstrated distal regulatory elements physically interact target gene promoters via 3D chromatin looping, thereby regulating expression genes located tens kilobases megabases away along linear genome. However, conventional annotation strategies typically assign putative regulatory elements (e.g., informed ChIP-seq peaks) nearest neighboring genes cis, often deviates actual biological mechanisms. Consequently, accurate assignment non-coding genetic variants orphan regulatory peaks cognate target genes represents major bottleneck functional annotation genomic regulatory elements. overcome challenge, looplook systematically prioritizes experimentally validated spatial chromatin contacts batch-annotate thousands regulatory elements genome-wide, high-throughput scale, thereby identifying candidate target genes high confidence systematic efficiency. Beyond utility integrative tool target gene annotation, looplook serves standalone platform dedicated chromatin loop analysis. Even absence auxiliary omics data, tool enables systematic annotation 3D chromatin interactome , classification complex spatial interaction topologies (e.g., Enhancer-Promoter, Promoter-Promoter interactions), quantification node connectivity, facilitates identification dense regulatory hubs enhancer cliques may represent candidate regulatory domains driving cell-type-specific transcriptional programs.

Numerous studies demonstrated many distal regulatory elements physically interact target gene promoters via 3D chromatin loopings, thereby regulating expression genes located tens kilobases megabases away linear genome. However, conventional annotations tend assign putative elements (peaks) nearest genes cis, often fails reflect biological reality. Hence, accurate assignment non-coding genetic variants orphan peaks cognate target genes remains major bottleneck target annotation functional elements. address , looplook systematically prioritizes physical spatial chromatin contacts batch-annotate thousands regulatory elements genome-wide, high-throughput scale, thereby identifying candidate target genes high confidence systematic efficiency. Beyond utility tool integrative target annotation, looplook can used standalone utility loop analysis per se. Even absence auxiliary omics data, systematically annotates 3D chromatin interactome , classifying complex spatial topologies (e.g., Enhancer-Promoter, Promoter-Promoter interactions) quantifying node connectivity uncover dense regulatory hubs enhancer cliques may represent candidate regulatory domains driving cell-type-specific transcriptional programs.

text: 3D genomics analyses, individual replicates typically exhibit certain degrees inconsistency noise. consolidate_chromatin_loops function serves foundational data-cleaning module, merging multiple replicates standardized, unified 3D chromatin interaction coordinate framework. Key Parameters: mode: Defines overarching merging algorithm. "consensus" mode (recommended) employs graph-based connected component analysis cluster nearby chromatin loop anchors across biological/technical samples. "intersect" mode applies strict reference-based filtering retain overlapping interactions, "union" mode retains detected interactions exploratory pan-tissue analyses. min_raw_score & min_score (Dual-Filter): min_raw_score acts pre-filter applied individual BEDPE files clustering (e.g., removing singleton noise help reduce computational memory overhead). min_score serves post-filter applied final merged chromatin interactome improve confidence. "consensus" "union" modes, representative score replicate-balanced: package first averages clustered loop scores within replicate, averages across replicates, one replicate denser loop calls dominate final score. gap: Defines maximum spatial distance (base pairs) allowed loop anchors consideration part physical cluster. blacklist_species: Automatically excludes chromatin loops overlapping high-variance, artifact-prone genomic regions (e.g., centromeres, telomeres) integrating official ENCODE blacklist specified species (e.g., "hg38", "mm10"). region_of_interest: Accepts auxiliary BED file (e.g., specific disease-associated locus ChIP-seq peak set) filter loops physical connectivity target genomic region.

Key Parameters: target_bed: pecifies auxiliary genomic features interest (e.g., GWAS SNPs, ATAC-seq peaks, transcription factor binding sites) require spatial target gene assignment. expr_matrix_file & sample_columns: Providing RNA-seq matrix allows engine activate Expression Pre-filter Tiebreaker logic, drastically reducing false-positive gene assignments genomic regions harboring multiple genes. neighbor_hop: advanced topological parameter 3D chromatin interactome network traversal. Target gene assignment uses neighbor_hop + 1 graph steps capture genes opposite anchors. value 0 restricts loop topology direct contacts (target genes searched within 1-hop); value 1 (Hub Mode) extends secondary network effects. tss_region: Defines spatial boundary gene promoters relative Transcription Start Site (TSS). Topological Hub Detection Quantifies structural node degrees (e.g., n_Linked_Promoters, n_Linked_Distal) rigorously deconstruct 3D interactome two complementary perspectives: promoter_centric_stats: Identifies core target genes regulated complex regulatory architectures (e.g., enhancer arrays transcription factories), distal_element_stats highlights high-connectivity non-coding regions facilitate discovery putative enhancer cliques. Feature--Target Mapping: Links 1D genomic features (e.g., GWAS risk SNPs, ATAC-seq peaks, ChIP-seq binding sites) putative target genes via 3D chromatin contacts, providing loop-based alternative linear proximity-based assignments.

title: Spatial mapping of 1D genomic features to 3D chromatin interaction targets — annotate_peaks_and_loops
text: Mapping Strategy Fallback Mechanism method prioritizes physical 3D chromatin contacts keeping strict fallback semantics separate. Regulated_promoter_genes reports promoter genes supported loop-anchor context, Assigned_Target_Genes preserves historical promoter-first 3D assignment, *_Filled columns add linear nearest-gene fallback strict 3D assignments empty. Regulated_promoter_Evidence, Regulated_promoter_Fallback_Evidence, target_gene_links provide row-level provenance decisions. Hierarchical Conflict Resolution address complex loci single anchor overlaps multiple promoters (e.g., dense gene clusters bidirectional promoters), function executes 3-step resolution: Biotype Prioritization: Selects highest-priority candidates functional class: Protein Coding > small-ncRNA (miRNA, snoRNA, snRNA, rRNA, scaRNA) > Antisense > lncRNA/ncRNA > Pseudogene. Expression Filter: Within selected biotype tier, excludes transcriptionally silent genes using user-provided expression matrix. gene tier expressed, candidates tier retained. Expression Tiebreaker: Among remaining candidates equal biotype priority, retains genes whose expression >= co_dominance_ratio x group maximum. Default 0.1 (one order magnitude; ~3.3-fold log2 space). co-dominant rule preserves functionally redundant candidates bidirectional promoter pairs, co-expressed partners typically fall within 2-3 fold . Edge case: candidates best biotype tier TPM = 0, retained (tiebreaker distinguish ), may produce multi-gene assignments transcriptionally silent loci. Network Topology Analysis Ego-Network Expansion (neighbor_hop): Implements k-hop neighborhood expansion via igraph::ego(). value 0 restricts direct contacts, 1 includes secondary contacts capture broader regulatory cliques. Hub Detection: Utilizes node-degree quantile threshold (hub_percentile) identify highly connected regulatory elements. Peak-Anchor Overlap Control target_bed provided, three parameters control target peaks matched loop anchors. act cascade increasingly stringent filters: anchor_gap – expands search radius around anchor. anchor_min_overlap – requires minimum physical overlap bp. anchor_min_frac – requires overlap cover minimum fraction peak. table lists suggested starting points common experimental designs. quiet = FALSE (default), function prints diagnostic line reporting many peaks overlapped loop anchors filtering, helping tune thresholds data.

title: Consolidate and Integrate Chromatin Loops from Replicates or Multiple Sources — consolidate_chromatin_loops
text: function consolidates chromatin loops multiple BEDPE files. designed two main purposes: Replicate Consolidation: Merging biological technical replicates identify high-confidence, reproducible loops (e.g., 3 replicates H3K27ac HiChIP). Multi-Omics Integration: framework can used identify multi-source consensus integrating datasets various experimental designs, HiChIP assays targeting different factors (e.g., integrating H3K27ac H3K4me3, overlapping Hi-C ChIA-PET). function supports three modes: "consensus": Implements graph-based connected component analysis cluster spatially proximal anchors across samples. retains clusters detected >= min_consensus biological replicates. "intersect": Reference-based filtering. Retains loops File 1 whose anchors overlap loops every file within specified gap tolerance. Coordinates scores inherited File 1 without merging. "union": Retains chromatin interactions across entire cohort, ideal exploratory pan-tissue analyses. Connected-component chaining: Graph-based clustering may transitively chain loci (-B B-C merge, pulling C cluster even far apart). default, warning emitted cluster span exceeds chaining threshold (max(3xgap, 5xmedian_anchor_width)). Use chaining_policy control behavior ("warn", "none", "drop", "error"). also supports two-stage filtering strategy improve signal--noise ratio: Pre-filtering (min_raw_score): Removes low-confidence noise (e.g., singleton reads) raw files merging. Post-filtering (min_score): Filters final consensus loops based aggregated score. Replicate-Balanced Aggregation: "consensus" "union" modes, cluster score computed mean per-source mean scores, one replicate many fragmented calls dominate final representative score.

title: Expression-Aware refinement of loop anchors and target linkages — refine_loop_anchors_by_expression
text: Algorithmic Framework: Target Filtration: Parses merged gene assignments (e.g., "GeneA;GeneB"), evaluates individual genes defined expression threshold, retains transcriptionally active targets. Biological Reclassification: Reclassifies physically annotated promoters (P) gene bodies (G) lacking active transcription expression-filtered silent regulatory elements (eP, eG). Important: eP/eG labels indicate transcriptional silence reference gene – constitute evidence enhancer activity. Orthogonal chromatin data (ATAC-seq, H3K27ac, H3K4me1) required functional enhancer interpretation. labels retained backward compatibility; interpret "inactive-P" / "inactive-G" rather "enhancer-P" / "enhancer-G". Expression-Aware Connectivity Statistics: Recomputes promoter-centric distal-element connectivity expression-aware anchor refinement, preserving structural loops refined loop annotation. separates complete physical contact map high-confidence active subset. External Target Refinement: Filters auxiliary target mapping columns (e.g., Assigned_Target_Genes_Filled) based expression criteria, ensuring mapped 1D genomic features exclusively linked active genes. Target Provenance Preservation: Recomputes *_Filled membership flags target_gene_links expression filtering, retains links still used refined target columns, appends Mean_Expression plus Passes_Expression_Filter. Evidence labels local_promoter_overlap, direct_opposite_promoter, linear_fallback preserved. Design Philosophy: function discard structural loops based expression state. Hi-C, HiChIP, PLAC-seq capture 3D chromatin contacts; RNA-seq captures current transcriptional state. silent promoter may reflect cell-state, time-point, technical factors rather absence physical contact. structural loops retained refinement status columns, high-confidence functional subset provided via Retained_In_Functional_Network Functional Loop Annotation Excel sheet. Interpretation eP/eG labels: eP eG expression-filtered silent states, functional enhancer classifications. Bulk RNA-seq silence can arise cell-type proportions, time-point effects, sequencing depth, promoter pausing – none imply locus gained enhancer activity. labels read "transcriptionally inactive P/G" treated hypotheses requiring orthogonal validation (ATAC-seq, H3K27ac, H3K4me1, H3K27me3 depletion). Users matched chromatin data overlay eP/eG loci tracks interpreting putative regulatory elements.
